increment: G2 native starting grid and heterogeneous field
limits: A nonzero grid initial speed is rejected by MultiVehicleSimulation; the original writes the public longitudinal speed before configuring the car and no shipped race configuration uses a rolling start. Placement itself carries and matches the value.
Heterogeneous fields are verified natively only: the reference harness reads one car XML per world, so a mixed field has no original counterpart.
Field cap stays 16 cars, as in MultiVehicleSimulation and RaceOrder; StartingGrid.slots allows up to 64 so the cap lives in one place.
Aalborg / 155-DTM pinned fixtures only; the default pole side depends on each track's first turn.
A grid longer than the track is rejected with a diagnostic, where the original would walk off the front of its segment list.
This increment places and steps a field. Race progression, pit assignment, penalties and driver selection are later increments.
Contacts were measured for a tight two-row grid on the starting straight; broader contact orders and content remain uncovered.
priority: Gameplay; foliage and new graphical work deferred
scope: Semantic initStartingGrid port, original grid parameter reading, and one car definition per car in MultiVehicleSimulation, compared against the original routine and original simuv2

verification.gating: Release suite gated on the three-digit total line with no runtime-failure, Fatal, failed-case or signal markers
verification.oracle: ref_world_grid_create placement-only grid world, compared per car and per field
